# Web page fixtures

Synthetic pages, hand-written on 2026-11-27 for the import-cleaning tests (no network fetching). Each one is
modelled on a typical layout and carries the chrome that commonly survives trafilatura inside the article
container: share lines, bylines, dates, "read more" links, tag lists, related links, newsletter and copyright
lines. The file name's first two letters are the page language.

| File | Modelled on | Saved |
|---|---|---|
| `es-news.html` | Spanish local news article (fictional "El Diario del Valle") | 2026-11-27 |
| `it-blog.html` | Italian cooking blog post (fictional "Cucina di casa") | 2026-11-27 |
| `en-institution.html` | English institutional press release (fictional "Regional Heritage Council") | 2026-11-27 |
